newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: WEGENER TO SELL MAJORITY OF TV STATION.
newsitem.headline: WEGENER TO SELL MAJORITY OF TV STATION.

text.p: Dutch publisher Wegener NV said on Thursday it expected to reach agreement on selling a majority stake in its Dutch commercial television station TV10 to Saban Entertainment Inc in the U.S.
Wegener said its unit Arcade Entertainment Group was discussing a close cooperation with Saban with regard to TV10.
Arcade's rock music station The Music Factory will not be included in a possible deal, Wegener said. No financial details were disclosed.

TV10 is a cable television station mainly broadcasting shows and series. Wegener said that the station wants to expand its broadcasting schedule to the morning hours with children programmes. TV10 can be seen by about 80 percent of Dutch cable television viewers.
